subject: VPC private deploy readiness — final checklist, smoke plan, and owners
messages:
From: Elinor Jacobs <elinor@heliobank.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: irene_choi@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 18 Apr 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Final readiness checkpoint + smoke window

Karthik / Irene —

Thanks for the detailed kickoff last week. We have one remaining gating item before we give the internal ops teams the green light to flip traffic: a compact, executable smoke plan and a clear list of owners for each step (network, certs, service accounts, KV priming, and rollback).

Two asks from my side so we can lock the maintenance window for next Wednesday 04/22 02:00–04:00 PT:
- A one-page runbook (or pointer to the latest runbook) with owners and timers.
- A short smoke checklist we can walk with our on-prem team during the window.

Also confirm any service accounts that need to be pre-provisioned by our IAM team so we don't get blocked during the window.

If possible, can you send the runbook + checklist by EOD today so I can circulate to HelioBank security and operations?

Thanks —
Elinor Jacobs
Senior Cloud Ops Lead, HelioBank
attachments: none

Cc: irene_choi@redwood.com, mina_haddad@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 18 Apr 2026 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Final readiness checkpoint + smoke window

Elinor —

Attached: redwood_private_runbook_v2.md (concise owner/timer runbook) and postdeploy_smoke_checklist.csv (step-by-step smoke tasks). High-level notes:

- Owners:
  * Network cut / ACL verification — Irene Choi (irene_choi)
  * Cert rotation & validation — Mina Haddad (mina_haddad)
  * Service accounts & IAM mapping — HelioBank IAM (please pre-provision list below)
  * KV cache priming / prefix warmup — Karthik (karthik_iyer)
  * Rollback & emergency throttle — Marissa Cole (marissa_cole)

- Maintenance window: your 04/22 02:00–04:00 PT works for us. We recommend breakpoints at +20m, +45m, +90m for decision points and a hard rollback at +120m if any blocking error surfaces.

- Pre-provisioned service accounts (please confirm these are created and that keys are uploaded to the secure bucket):
  * heliobank-redis-writer@heliobank.iam
  * heliobank-observe-puller@heliobank.iam
  * heliobank-deploy-runner@heliobank.iam

- Attachments include a minimal network topology snapshot (vpc_network_topology.png) referenced in the runbook.

I'll follow up in ~30m with a network verification checklist from Irene and a brief smoke-script summary.

-k

Karthik Iyer
Principal PM, Private Deployments — Redwood Inference
Attachments: redwood_private_runbook_v2.md, postdeploy_smoke_checklist.csv
From: irene_choi@redwood.com
To: Elinor Jacobs <elinor@heliobank.com>, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: mina_haddad@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 18 Apr 2026 11:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Final readiness checkpoint + smoke window

Elinor / team —

Couple of concrete network verification points I'm adding to the runbook (excerpted):

1) BGP adjacency check (edge routers) — confirm peers ESTABLISHED from both sides; sample commands and expected output included in runbook.
2) ACLs — 3 tagged ACLs to allow: control-plane (TCP 9000-9010), agent-heartbeat (UDP 17000-17010), prometheus-scrape (TCP 9090).
3) MTU / fragmentation — verify 9000 MTU on the transit fabric; if not, reduce jumbo frames to 1500 and disable GSO offload for the agent hosts during the window.
4) IP routing path validation — we will run a traffic-mirroring test for 5 minutes prior to the flip and confirm upstream NAT table entries.

Note about service accounts: we need heliobank-deploy-runner to have a short-lived key with a TTL of 4h and a documented KMS binding. See the service_account_matrix.xlsx attached.

I placed a small checklist snippet in the Drive link Karthik shared (network preflight section). Will join the bridge for the window and lead the validation steps.

-Irene

Irene Choi
Network Reliability Eng — Redwood Inference
Attachments referenced: vpc_network_topology.png, service_account_matrix.xlsx
From: Elinor Jacobs <elinor@heliobank.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, irene_choi@redwood.com
Cc: NetFabric Ops <deploy@netfabric.io>
Date: Sat, 18 Apr 2026 13:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Final readiness checkpoint + smoke window

Thanks Karthik / Irene —

HelioBank ops confirms they will provision the three accounts this afternoon and will provide the key upload to your secure bucket before EOD. NetFabric will also stand by during the window for any BGP table adjustments.

A few quick clarifying items from our compliance team: can you confirm whether any sensitive logs will be exported off-network during the smoke (we want to avoid PII leaving the VPC)? If there is export it must be disabled until the post-activation review.

Also, please confirm the exact Slack channel + bridge URL you'll use for real-time coordination. We prefer a single channel for all alerts.

Forwarding below for visibility.

-On Elinor

Date: Sat, 18 Apr 2026 16:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Final readiness checkpoint + smoke window — owners & bridge

Team — quick confirmation & run-of-show for 04/22: 

- Bridge: https://redwood.zoom.us/j/923456789 (primary) and Slack channel #heliobank-private-deploy (alerts only).
- 01:50 PT — ingress mirroring test (Irene lead)
- 02:00 PT — traffic flip start, apply ACL subset and monitor latency/err rates (Marissa lead)
- +20m (02:20) — quick health check: N requests / 95th latency / 5xx rate; decision: continue / rollback
- +45m (02:45) — KV cache priming complete; sample inference traffic validated against golden prompts (Karthik lead)
- +90m (03:30) — final validation and start of gradual post-cutover scaling (Mina lead)
- +120m (04:00) — window end; if rollback required, ops will reapply previous ACLs and we will restore traffic to pre-cutover route.

Compliance note: No logs with PII will be shipped outside the VPC during the smoke. We will keep metrics-only exports to the monitoring workspace — raw traces remain on-prem.

Please reply-all with any objections before EOD today; otherwise we consider this the agreed run-of-show and will produce a final single-page runbook to attach to the change ticket.

Marissa Cole
Director, Customer Reliability — Redwood Inference
Attachments: none
